import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static int[] Parent;
    static int[] Rank;

    static int findParent(int nd) {
        if (Parent[nd] != nd) {
            Parent[nd] = findParent(Parent[nd]);
        }
        return Parent[nd];
    }

    static void union(int nd1, int nd2) {
        if (Rank[nd1] >= Rank[nd2]) {
            Parent[nd2] = nd1;
            Rank[nd1]++;
        } else {
            Parent[nd1] = nd2;
            Rank[nd2]++;
        }
    }

    static long fastExpPow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long res = 1;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * base) % mod;
            }
            exp >>= 1;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int P = sc.nextInt();
        int K = sc.nextInt();
        sc.close();

        Parent = new int[P + 1];
        Rank = new int[P + 1];

        // REP(i, 1, P) in original code: i from 1 to P-1 (half-open)
        for (int i = 1; i < P; i++) {
            Parent[i] = i;
            Rank[i] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < P; i++) {
            int value = (int)(((long)K * i) % P);
            int pa = findParent(i);
            int pb = findParent(value);
            if (pa != pb) {
                union(pa, pb);
            }
        }

        Set<Integer> groups = new HashSet<>();
        for (int i = 1; i < P; i++) {
            groups.add(findParent(i));
        }

        long ways;
        if (K == 0) {
            ways = fastExpPow(P, P - 1, MOD);
        } else if (K == 1) {
            ways = fastExpPow(P, P, MOD);
        } else {
            ways = fastExpPow(P, groups.size(), MOD);
        }

        System.out.println(ways);
    }
}
